hero.title: Too Many Customs Documents?
hero.subtitle: Manage Them More Easily with Trade2Gov.
hero.description: For importers, exporters, and customs brokers handling high transaction volumes or complex documentation processes, Trade2Gov helps prepare customs documents, manage archives and reports, integrate systems, and monitor process statuses in one digital platform.

about.label: About Us
about.introTitle: Over 30 Years of Supporting Indonesia's Trade Digitalization
about.introDescription: Trade2Gov is developed by PT Electronic Data Interchange Indonesia (EDII), a pioneer in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) services in Indonesia since 1995.
about.storyTitle: From an EDI Pioneer to a Digital Customs Platform
about.story1995Description: Pioneering Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) services for trade in Indonesia.
about.storyInternationalDescription: Connected with electronic data interchange service providers across Asia and Europe.
about.storyTodayDescription: A web-based customs portal used by more than 250 companies.
about.storyParagraph1: PT Electronic Data Interchange Indonesia (EDII) was established on June 1, 1995, as a pioneer of Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) services in Indonesia. For more than 30 years, we have helped government institutions, state-owned enterprises, importers, exporters, shipping companies, banks, and industries including pharmaceuticals, retail, and automotive exchange trade documents quickly and securely.
about.storyParagraph2: We have transformed that experience into Trade2Gov, a web-based customs portal that brings together document creation, archive storage, automated document reading, and system integration in one place.
about.storyParagraph3: In addition to Trade2Gov, EDII also provides IT consulting, system development and integration, IT system management, and cloud-based EDI services.
about.certification: Certified with ISO/IEC 27001 for information security and ISO 9001 for quality management.
about.fact1995: Established as a pioneer of EDI in Indonesia
about.valueIntegratedDescription: Customs documents, archives, document reading, and system integration are connected in one platform.
about.valueSimplicityDescription: Complex customs processes are made simpler for teams to manage every day.
about.valueInnovativeDescription: Our services are continuously updated to keep pace with technological developments and user needs.
about.networkTitle: Connected with Partners Across Asia and Europe
about.networkDescription: Through interconnection partnerships with electronic data interchange service providers in other countries, companies in Indonesia can exchange documents and data with their business partners automatically, securely, and reliably. This network forms the foundation of Trade2Gov's Cross Border services.
about.clientsDescription: From government institutions, state-owned enterprises, banking, pharmaceuticals, and retail to the automotive industry. Here are some of the companies using Trade2Gov.
about.demoTitle: Want to See Trade2Gov in Action?
about.demoDescription: Schedule a demo with our team and discuss your company's customs requirements.

automation.title: Documents Are Still Processed Manually
automation.intro: Many customs teams still read invoices and packing lists one by one, then manually enter the data into customs document drafts. As volumes increase, this administrative work takes up a significant amount of time.
automation.problemDescription: Invoices, packing lists, Bills of Lading, and Air Waybills arrive in different formats from each supplier. Reading, classifying, and retyping the data extends document preparation time.
automation.solutionDescription: ScanGenius reads supporting documents using OCR, extracts important data, and then prepares a customs document draft. The team only needs to review the results instead of entering everything from scratch.
automation.metric1: Average time required to prepare one document
automation.metric3: Number of data corrections before a document is submitted
automation.ctaDescription: During the demo, we will process sample documents and show you the extraction results.

integration.title: Data Scattered Across Multiple Systems
integration.intro: When the same data must be transferred from an ERP to partner applications and then into customs documents, teams spend time copying and reconciling it. The more documents there are, the greater the chance of discrepancies.
integration.imageAlt: API Collaboration Platform diagram connecting cargo owners, freight forwarders, ports, and authorities to CEISA
integration.imageCaption: Overview of the Trade2Gov API connected to CEISA
integration.problemText: ERP systems, internal applications, and customs systems use different data formats and workflows. Without an integration layer, data exchange is handled manually: copy, paste, and check again.
integration.solutionText: The Trade2Gov API connects your internal systems with Trade2Gov. Data can be sent in real time or in scheduled batches. Its format is adapted, checked automatically, and resent if delivery fails.
integration.metricOne: Number of re-entry steps per document
integration.metricTwo: Number of manual processes between applications
integration.metricThree: Time required to resolve data discrepancies
integration.ctaTitle: Want to see an integration example?
integration.ctaText: During the demo, we will show how data from your systems enters customs documents, including what happens when a transmission fails.

monitoring.title: Process Statuses Are Difficult to Track
monitoring.intro: When document statuses are scattered across several places, a simple question like “where does this document stand?” requires repeated checking.
monitoring.imageAlt: e-Declaration dashboard showing document counts by type
monitoring.problemText: Status changes, CEISA responses, and documents requiring follow-up need to reach the right people. Without a centralized view, coordination slows down.
monitoring.solutionText: e-Declaration displays document counts and statuses by type, CEISA responses, notifications, and document tracking menus. Teams can also monitor them through the EDII Mobile application.
monitoring.metricOne: Time needed to find the latest status of a document
monitoring.metricTwo: Number of manual checks per day
monitoring.metricThree: Time needed to follow up on responses requiring attention
monitoring.ctaText: During the demo, we will show the document workflow, CEISA responses, and sample reports.

document.title: What counts as one document?
document.answer: One customs document created and submitted to CEISA, such as one PIB or one PEB.

quota.title: What happens when the monthly quota runs out?
quota.answer: With subscription plans, you can still submit documents. Each document exceeding the quota is charged Rp10,000. PAYG plans are limited to a maximum of 30 documents per month; for higher volumes, choose a subscription plan.

scanGenius.title: Is ScanGenius included in the plan?
scanGenius.answer: No. ScanGenius is an add-on service priced at Rp25,000 per processed document and is available for all plans.

annualContract.title: Are annual contracts available?
annualContract.answer: Yes, for all subscription plans. The annual contract value is calculated as the monthly price × 12.

changePlan.title: Can I change my plan?
changePlan.answer: Yes. Contact our team and we will help adjust your plan based on your document volume and team requirements.
